title: Audacity 4 is a complete revamp of the ‘world’s most popular’ audio editor
summary: Audacity 4 has been in the works for some time, and had its own mini controversy last year when an unfortunate redesigned logo started making the rounds. llm_summary: Audacity 4 marks a major overhaul of the once‑ubiquitous free audio editor, bringing a fresh UI, modernized workflow and a host of performance upgrades. After a brief stir over a poorly‑received draft logo last fall, the final new icon has been rolled out without fanfare.
